cv.title: Improve your CV without inventing evidence
cv.subtitle: Review structure, role relevance and ATS risks using your confirmed CV sections and existing LumaPath evidence. Every wording change stays a draft until you approve it.
cv.privacyText: CV files and pasted text are owner-scoped personal data. LumaPath uses deterministic local analysis here and does not send CV content to a model or third party. Choose a retention period and delete the source or analysis whenever you want.
cv.addHint: Upload PDF, DOCX or TXT, or paste the text directly. You will review parsed sections before any analysis runs.
cv.retentionHint: The source and derived CV record expire automatically at the selected limit.
cv.fileHint: PDF, DOCX or UTF-8 TXT · maximum 8 MB
cv.libraryHint: Only your current student identity can access these records.
cv.empty: No CVs yet. Upload or paste one to begin.
cv.selectEmpty: Select a CV to review its parsed sections and analysis.
cv.parseFailedTitle: The source was preserved, but parsing failed
cv.parseFailedPreserved: The original accepted source is still private and unchanged. You can delete it at any time; LumaPath will not fabricate parsed sections.
cv.reviewHint: Correct headings or text before confirming. Analysis is blocked until you approve this representation.
cv.reviewConfirmedHint: These reviewed sections are the source of truth for analysis. Delete and re-add the CV if you need to rebuild the parsed structure.
cv.analysisGateHint: Analysis uses only these confirmed sections, the selected role taxonomy and your existing Portfolio evidence.
cv.findingsHint: Each finding includes a rationale and a concrete next action.
cv.skillsHint: This shows what the reviewed CV or existing Portfolio evidence demonstrates for the selected role.
cv.skillsDisclaimer: “Not demonstrated” means no matching evidence is visible in this CV. It does not mean you do not have the skill.
cv.suggestionsHint: Nothing here is authoritative. Edit every draft, verify every claim, then approve or dismiss it individually.
cv.noSuggestions: No wording drafts were generated from the available evidence.
cv.confirm.deleteSource: Delete the original CV source? Reviewed sections and existing analysis will remain until you delete them separately.
cv.confirm.deleteAnalysis: Delete all analysis snapshots and suggestions for this CV? The source and reviewed sections will remain.
cv.confirm.deleteAll: Delete this CV, its source, reviewed sections and all analysis data? This cannot be undone.

careerEngine.roleHelp: Role requirements are versioned and validated before publication. Changing roles does not erase transferable completed work.
careerEngine.approvedTaxonomyNote: Only approved taxonomy requirements are used. AI cannot silently add role requirements.
careerEngine.assessmentHelp: Combines self-assessment with available quiz, CV, project, repository and prior-roadmap evidence. Every source keeps its confidence.
careerEngine.assessmentSaved: Skill assessment updated from the evidence currently available.
careerEngine.assessmentFailed: The skill assessment could not be updated. Existing assessment data was not changed.
careerEngine.conflictNotice: {count} skill estimate(s) contain materially conflicting evidence. Review the source labels before planning.
careerEngine.noAssessment: No server-owned assessment exists for this role yet. Run the assessment before generating a roadmap.
careerEngine.requirementsHelp: Missing prerequisites are ordered before advanced outcomes. Required proficiency is a planning threshold, not a hiring score.
careerEngine.resourceRankingNote: Resources are ranked by editorial quality and your declared cost, language, format and type preferences. Missing facts stay unknown.
careerEngine.missingMetadata: Some resource metadata is unavailable. LumaPath has left those fields unknown instead of guessing.
careerEngine.roadmapReadyTitle: Turn the reviewed gap into a weekly plan
careerEngine.roadmapReadyBody: Your latest assessment is ready. The Roadmap will use this server-owned evidence and keep Planner changes behind a separate approval.
careerEngine.roadmapBlockedBody: Complete the skill assessment first. Roadmap generation will not trust client-only skill claims when DOC-F29 is active.
careerEngine.loadFailed: The career taxonomy could not be loaded.
careerEngine.assessmentRequiredForRoadma: DOC-F29 requires a current server-owned skill assessment for this role before roadmap generation or recalculation.
evidencePassport.title: Skills backed by evidence
evidencePassport.subtitle: Review what supports each skill, where it came from, how current it is, and exactly what you choose to share.
evidencePassport.loadFailed: The Evidence Passport could not be loaded.
evidencePassport.noEvidenceForSkill: No evidence is currently linked to this skill. Add a certificate, complete an assessment, analyse a project, or request mentor validation.
evidencePassport.emptyBody: Complete a career assessment or add evidence to connect skills to provenance.
evidencePassport.shareCreated: Scoped evidence share created and copied.
evidencePassport.shareFailed: Evidence sharing could not be updated.
evidencePassport.sharePrivacy: Only the selected evidence summaries are exposed. Private originals and unrelated records remain hidden.
evidencePassport.correctionPrompt: Explain the correction or dispute. This note stays private unless you explicitly share the evidence.
evidencePassport.revalidated: Evidence review timestamp updated. This does not independently verify authenticity.
evidencePassport.saveFailed: Evidence change could not be saved.
evidencePassport.certificatePrivacy: Certificate metadata is self-declared unless a trusted verification source is added later. Do not upload private originals here.
evidencePassport.mentorValidationBody: Ask an active mentor to review one skill. The request itself is explicit consent; the mentor sees only the skill and note needed for that review.
evidencePassport.mentorNotePlaceholder: Optional context for this skill review
evidencePassport.noShares: No active or previous evidence shares.
evidenceShare.unavailable: This evidence share is unavailable, expired, or revoked.
evidenceShare.privacy: This page contains only evidence explicitly selected by the student. Verification status describes the evidence source; it is not a guarantee of professional proficiency or credential authenticity.
mentorView.evidenceValidationBody: These requests were explicitly sent by the student. Review only the named skill and evidence context you actually know.
mentorView.noValidationRequests: No skill validation requests are waiting.
mentorView.validationDisputed: Evidence does not support the claim
mentorView.validationNotePrompt: Add a factual review note. Do not infer ability beyond the evidence you reviewed.
mentorView.validationFailed: Skill evidence validation could not be saved.
evidencePassport.deleteCertificateConfir: Delete this certificate evidence? This removes the active certificate record from your Passport.
teams.title: Team Workspaces
teams.subtitle: Plan group milestones, divide shared work with consent-controlled suggestions, and keep a factual project history without exposing private student data.
teams.privacyBody: Team workspaces are separate from your personal Tasks. Grades, private capacity/check-ins, CV content and personal notes are never shared. Allocation can use only the limited availability and skill summary each member explicitly enables.
teams.noTeams: No team workspaces yet. Create one or join with an invitation token.
teams.joinHelp: Paste the one-time invitation token shared by your team coordinator.
teams.selectTeam: Select a team workspace to continue.
teams.noDescription: No team description has been added.
teams.confirmRemove: Remove this member? Access stops immediately, while legitimate activity history remains.
teams.removalReason: Membership removed by the team owner.
teams.invitePermission: Only the team owner or a coordinator can create invitations.
teams.inviteCreated: Invitation created. Share the token through a trusted channel.
teams.copyInviteOnce: Copy this one-time invitation token. It is not shown again after this view is cleared.
teams.sharingHelp: You control the limited information used for allocation suggestions. Turning sharing off affects future suggestions and does not erase project history.
teams.weeklyMinutes: Minutes available for team work per week
teams.availabilityPrivacy: This is a member-declared team-work allowance. LumaPath does not expose private capacity check-ins or personal schedules.
teams.skillPrivacy: Only the selected skill IDs and current assessment summary are shared. Other evidence and private source material stay private.
teams.projectsHelp: Projects have an explicit owner while authorised active members can create milestones, tasks and meeting notes.
teams.allocationBody: Suggestions use only explicitly shared skills, member-declared team availability and current group assignments. They do not judge effort, motivation or ability.
teams.confirmAssignment: Confirm this assignment after reviewing the member-shared skill and availability rationale?
teams.assignmentConfirmedByHuman: Assignment reviewed and explicitly confirmed by a team coordinator.
teams.noAllocationSuggestions: No open tasks need allocation suggestions.
teams.contributionHelp: Recorded actions are shown factually and are never turned into a leaderboard or effort score.
teams.correctedEvent: This event has a correction record; the original is retained for audit history.
teams.confirmLeave: Leave this team? Your access will stop immediately, while legitimate shared-project history remains.
teams.leaveReason: Member chose to leave the team.
teams.correctionReason: Why is this activity record inaccurate?
programmeAnalytics.title: Cohort trends for better student support
programmeAnalytics.description: Review anonymous aggregate signals across authorised cohorts, understand what each metric means, and turn trends into programme-level support actions without exposing individual students.
programmeAnalytics.loadError: Programme analytics could not be loaded safely.
programmeAnalytics.invalidPeriod: Choose a valid period where the start date is on or before the end date.
programmeAnalytics.noCohortsHint: Cohort membership must be provisioned from an approved institutional source. LumaPath does not invent cohort membership or expose student records here.
programmeAnalytics.aggregateTrend: Aggregate movement over the selected period
programmeAnalytics.sliceSuppressed: Slice hidden because too few contributors were available
programmeAnalytics.noSkillSlices: No approved skill slices are available for this period.
programmeAnalytics.noTrendData: No unsuppressed trend points are available for this period.
programmeAnalytics.controlsHint: Minimum contributor threshold: {threshold}. Aggregate retention: {days} days. Small slices are suppressed and exports never include student identifiers.
programmeAnalytics.exportError: Aggregate export could not be prepared.
programmeAnalytics.minimumPeriod: Choose a period of at least 7 calendar days to protect against re-identification through very small time slices.
opportunities.preparationHint: LumaPath turns unmet or unknown requirements into an editable checklist, then proposes time before the deadline using your current planning capacity. Nothing enters Planner until you approve it.
opportunities.preparationBuilt: Preparation checklist created. Review it before approval.
opportunities.confirmPreparation: I reviewed the checklist, source deadline and proposed times. Add only the selected tasks after I approve.
opportunities.preparationAlreadyApproved: This preparation plan was already approved; no duplicate tasks were added.
opportunities.trackingHint: Track your own progress only. LumaPath does not submit applications or infer employer decisions.
opportunities.resultPlaceholder: e.g. Interview invited, Not selected, Withdrawn
opportunities.alertsPaused: Deadline alerts are paused because the current source status is {status}. Your tracking history is preserved.
careerCompare.loadFailed: Career comparison data could not be loaded.
careerCompare.compareFailed: The comparison could not be calculated. Your active roadmap was not changed.
careerCompare.created: Career comparison created from a versioned snapshot.
careerCompare.recomputed: Scenario recalculated. The earlier result is preserved unchanged.
careerCompare.saveFailed: Scenario retention could not be updated.
careerCompare.switchFailed: The pathway draft could not be created. Your active roadmap was not changed.
careerCompare.draftCreated: A reviewable {role} roadmap draft is ready.
careerCompare.title: Compare career directions before you change course
careerCompare.subtitle: Compare skill overlap, reusable evidence, remaining effort, time and resource-cost assumptions without changing your active roadmap.
careerCompare.draftReady: Pathway draft created — active roadmap unchanged
careerCompare.chooseHelp: LumaPath snapshots the approved taxonomy and your reusable evidence, then compares the same context across every selected role.
careerCompare.emptyBody: Select at least two supported careers. Estimates remain ranges, missing data stays visible, and nothing changes your current pathway.
careerCompare.noneCredited: No skills are credited from the current evidence snapshot.
careerCompare.switchDescription: This creates a reviewable draft only. It will preserve reusable evidence and transferable completed skills. Your active roadmap stays unchanged until you separately approve the draft in Roadmap.
careerCompare.noTransferable: No transferable skills are currently credited. Missing evidence is not treated as failure.
careerCompare.confirmSwitch: I understand this creates a draft only and does not automatically change my active career goal or roadmap.
careerCompare.budgetEnvelope: Planning envelope up to {amount}; this is not a publisher price quote.
careerCompare.unknownPrices: {count} certification price(s) are unknown and were not guessed.
marketSignals.title: Market signals & pathway updates
marketSignals.description: Compare approved regional and international role profiles, understand reviewed market changes, and decide whether your roadmap should be recalculated. Market evidence never changes your goal automatically.
marketSignals.studentLoadError: Market profile information is unavailable. Your active roadmap was not changed.
marketSignals.noRegionalHint: LumaPath will not invent a regional profile when reviewed evidence is unavailable.
marketSignals.noUpdatesHint: There are no reviewed taxonomy changes waiting for your decision.
marketSignals.draftCreated: A reviewable roadmap draft was created. Your active roadmap is unchanged.
marketSignals.actionFailed: The action could not be completed. No roadmap state was changed.
marketSignals.aiCannotApprove: AI may summarize grounded evidence, but it cannot approve or publish taxonomy changes.
marketSignals.noSignalsHint: Signals appear only after governed source, sample, freshness and confidence checks.
marketSignals.noProposalsHint: Observed signals remain separate until a curator explicitly creates a proposal.
marketSignals.recalculateDescription: This uses the approved taxonomy update to create a new draft for review. Your current active roadmap stays unchanged until you separately approve the draft.
marketSignals.recalculateConfirm: I understand this creates a draft only and does not silently replace my current roadmap, goal, or completed skill evidence.
marketSignals.decisionDescription: Record a human decision and rationale. Approval publishes a new immutable taxonomy version; rejection preserves the current version.
marketSignals.rationalePlaceholder: Document the evidence review, limitations, bias considerations, and decision rationale…
marketSignals.proposalApproved: Proposal approved and a new immutable taxonomy version was published.
marketSignals.proposalRejected: Proposal rejected. The active taxonomy was not changed.
